payload.description_html: Tromerosaurus is a medium-sized tyrannosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period in what is now Canada. It was a bipedal carnivore that grew to approximately 7 m in total body length. Tromerosaurus had many intermediate traits found among contemporary tyrannosaurs, revealing insight about how different lineages diverged and coexisted.
